are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
xchi: xchi — shall; the future prefix xchi-, written apart before the person prefix and the verb
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you') · ka — second (inferred); kab' 'second' written without its b', as uka 'a second (pit)' · ka — (unclear) a particle before a verb or a word of state, left unrendered
ꜩihoh: tzijoj — they told / tell; root tzij 'word' + -oj verbalizer
calaxic: kalaxik — their being born (inferred); k- (ki 'their' before a vowel) + al 'child' + -ax (passive) + -ik
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain · Junajpu — also the name of a mountain (Brasseur: the Volcán de Fuego)
xbalanque: Xb'alanke — Xbalanque; name of the second of the two boys, with Hunahpu; make-up uncertain (Brasseur: x- diminutive + balam 'jaguar')
arecut: arek'ut — this then, so then; are 'this is' + cut 'then' written as one word
biyh: b'iyj — say, tell; the verb b'ij 'say' with its letters in another order, as in xchicabyih
ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose · ta — hear, understand; transitive verb (xki ta 'they heard') · ta — after mawi, marks the negation (mawi utz ta chuxoq 'it is not good that it be'); particle
vꜫih: uq'ij — its sun; u- 'its' + q'ij 'sun' · uq'ij — his day (of a person; Brasseur 'his glory'); sense uncertain
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
capoh: q'apoj — maiden, young woman; noun, written with plain c where Brasseur reads gapoh (his g is ꜫ); the q' is restored (inferred)
xquic: xkik' — Xquic, the maiden's name; Brasseur takes it as the prefix x (ix), which makes a woman's name, + quic 'blood' or 'rubber' ('la Femme-Sang ou la Gomme-Noire'), inferred; kik' 'blood' is the known word; kept as a name
vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun
xu: xu — it (did); x- completive + u- 'it', singular of xki
vachih: wachij — (uncertain) effort (inferred, after Brasseur); not otherwise known
atit: atit — grandmother; noun (also in Ratit) · atit — old woman; noun
xe: xe — they; x- completive + e 'they', before an intransitive verb (xe na'ojinik 'they pondered'); also xe' 'root' in the title line · xe' — the foot, the bottom of (a tree, a mountain, a ravine); xe' 'root, foot', before the noun · xe — x- completive + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (inferred; mi xe a calaba 'have you ruined them')
alaxic: alaxik — being born; al 'child, bear a child' + passive -ax- + -ik, as in xe alaxik 'they were born'
chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb) · chik — again: chic with its final c shared with the next word (xki chi k'ut, xech'a chi k'u) · chi — with, of (chi ixim 'with maize'); also 'that' before a verb (chi qajaj 'that we carve') · chi' — mouth (ca chi 'our mouth', qui chi 'their mouths'); noun, same letters as the preposition · chi — ch- (command) + i- 'you (pl.)', before a verb · chik — any more (ꜭo chi vi 'is there any more'); chic with its c not written
yaqueic: yakeik — (guess) bearing, ways; not otherwise known, taken from its pairing with k'oje'ik 'being' (Brasseur 'coutumes') · yakeik — (guess) come forth, be born; in que yaqueic of the unborn twins, after Brasseur 'peu s'en fallait pour la naissance'
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
caib: ka'ib' — two; numeral, ka'- with -ib' (the root of ukab' 'its second' and ukab'al 'the second')
qui: ki — their; 3pl possessive/ergative prefix · ki — k- 'ongoing' + i- 'you (pl.)', written qui like the prefix 'their'; also k- + i(n) 'I' (inferred) · ki — fermented drink (inferred); noun, in qa ki 'our drink', after Brasseur · ki — how, so (inferred); a word of degree before utz 'good' · qi — truly (qi tzij 'truly'); written apart from tzij 'word', as qui ꜩih, after Brasseur's quitzih · ki — they (inferred); the person of the verb in qui caiih 'they look at it', as Brasseur reads it
bi: b'i' — name; noun, here 'their name' after ki 'their'
pa: pa — in, at; preposition · pa — question particle after mi, 'has it…?' (mi pa xutzin 'has he finished?') · pa — after naqi, 'what (is it)?' (naqi pa); a particle of the question · pa — question particle after other words too: ma pa 'is it not that …?', ꜭo chi pa 'is there still …?'
huiub: juyub' — mountain; noun, huyub written with i for y
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads') · wi — part of wikiq'ab' 'right (hand)' (inferred), written apart (vi qui cab, set against mox 'left')
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state · ok — enter; verb (que rah oc pa hul 'they want to enter a hollow') · -oq — ending after a verb of motion marking the direction, written apart (apon oq 'arrive there')
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
ha: ja' — water; noun · ja — house (modern ja; que rah acanic chuvi ha 'they want to climb on the house') · ja — go! (a command, inferred, after Brasseur)
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (ke qa chak 'we defeat them', qa- 'we') · qe — us (the object after an agent noun, camol qe 'taker of us'); q- 'we, us' + e
he: je — (inferred) go; a form of the verb 'go', after Brasseur, read with ho 'we go' and hix 'you go'; the person is unclear
a: a — your, you (one person); a- 'your' before a noun, a- 'you' before a verb · a — (inferred) river, water; after Brasseur (chi quiqi-a 'at the river of blood')
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
catecut: k'atek'ut — then; k'ate 'then' + k'ut written as one word
ya: ya — give; verb (ku ya 'he gives') · ya — river, water (inferred, after Brasseur); noun, the letters respelled as written · ya — put, set; the 'give' verb used of placing a thing (qui ya 'they put it', chi ya chuvi ꜫaꜫ 'put it on the fire')
quz: kus — (inferred) sweet, savoury; after Brasseur ('savoureux'), plain qu where he reads guz; adjective (quz vvach 'sweet its fruit')
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut · ku — k- 'ongoing' + u- 'he', written cu like the particle (cu nimarizah rib 'he makes himself great')
el: el — go out; verb (kat el 'you go out')
chuvi: chuwi' — on top of; chi + u- 'its' + wi' 'head, top', relational noun · chuwi' — (inferred) after, later (of time), in ka chuwi' chik 'later on'; after Brasseur ('ensuite de cela')
quix: kix — you all (with an ongoing/commanded action); k- + ix 'you (pl.)' · kix — (uncertain) a verb after kat, 'be ashamed' or 'prick' (inferred), in kat kix la uloq
xcah: xqaj — it went down; x- completive + qaj 'descend' · xkaj — they wanted; x- completive + k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + aj 'want', as in xraj 'he wanted'
hunbaꜩ: Junb'atz' — Hunbatz; name of the elder son of Hunhunahpu; jun 'one' + b'atz', a day name (also 'thread, monkey'); kept as a name
hunchouen: Junchowen — Hunchouen; name of the second son of Hunhunahpu; jun 'one' + chowen, a day name; kept as a name
cam: k'am — take; verb · kam — die; verb
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch · pu — in, at (inferred); pa 'in', in pu chi' 'in the mouth' · pu — in its, in the; pa 'in' + u- 'its' contracted (Brasseur: pu for pa u, p'u 'dans le'), as pu b'eal 'by the road', pu wi' ja 'in the top of the house'
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki- · qumal — by us; r- 'by' form rumal with qa- 'we' (Brasseur kumal, his k is q)
maui: mawi — not, no; negative particle, before a noun or verb
chac: chak — (inferred) beat, defeat; after Brasseur ('afin que nous les vainquions'); the modern verb 'win' is ch'ak, but the word is uncertain and the ejective is not restored
xa: xa — only, just, merely; particle · xa — you (did); x- completive + a- 'you', before a verb (xa riqo 'you found it'), the same letters as xa 'only'
icou: ik'ow — pass; verb, without -ik when more follows in the clause
etamanel: etamanel — one who knows, sage; agent noun from etaman 'know' + -el
xere: xere — just so, this is how, only this; adverb
ahcot: ajkot — carver; aj- 'one who' + kot 'carve'; the plain k is kept (Brasseur's q suggests k'ot, undecided)
ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
chuꜩin: chutzin — that it come right; ch- optative + utzin 'come right' (from utz 'good')
nauinac: nawinaq — wise, those who have come to know (inferred); nao 'know' + -inaq, the state reached; stative
vꜫexel: uq'exel — its replacement, what is put in exchange; u- 'its' + q'exel (modern k'exel)
cahau: kajaw — father; noun, paired with chuch
xebe: xeb'e — they went; x- completive + e 'they' + b'e 'go'
xibalba: Xib'alb'a — Xibalba; the world below, the realm of the lords of death, which the missionaries took for 'hell' (Brasseur's note); kept as a name · Xib'alb'a — the people of Xibalba, its lords and inhabitants together (xeꜭha Xibalba 'Xibalba said', ronohel Xibalba 'all Xibalba')
ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x
vinaquir: winaqir — come into being, become a person; root winaq 'person' + -ir inchoative
xel: xel — it went out, they went out; x- completive + el 'go out', with no -ik because more follows in the clause
apanoc: apanoq — later, in time (guess); not otherwise known · apanoq — away, over there; apan 'go there' + -oq, after a verb of motion
nauiquil: nawikil — (inferred) all knowledge, every art; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('the whole of knowledge') and the list of crafts that follows it
chiquih: chiqij — behind us; chi + q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel, written qu) + ij 'back', relational noun · chikij — behind them; chi + k- 'their' (ki- before a vowel) + ij 'back'
vyoc: uyok — its wounding (guess); u- 'its' + a word not otherwise known; sense taken from Brasseur ('what wounded the heart')
vvbanic: wub'anik — blowgunning; the noun of wub'aj + -ik, in ki wub'anik 'their blowgunning'
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
hutaꜫih: jutaq'ij — every day; jun 'one' + taq 'each' + q'ij 'day'
ratit: Ratit — its grandmother; r- 'its' + atit 'grandmother'; in Ratit Q'ij, Ratit Saq
va: wa — this; demonstrative · wa — food, the maize tortilla (ca va 'our food', modern wa)
vlic: ulik — arrived here; ul 'arrive here' + -ik, ending at the end of a clause
ꜭoheic: k'oje'ik — being, existence; k'oje' 'be, exist' + -ik, verbal noun
zac: saq — white, light; adjective, root saq · saq — (inferred) white dice or knucklebones, in xa saq, xa chaaj 'only the white (dice), only play'; after Brasseur · saq — (inferred) make clear, speak out; saq 'white, clear' used as a verb (xki saq ki tzij 'they spoke their word out'), after Brasseur ('délivrèrent leur message')
quilo: qilo — we see (it); q- 'we' (written qu before a vowel) + il 'see' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb
cucaam: kukaam — (inferred) carrying it; k- + u- (singular) + kam 'take' with a long vowel, after Brasseur (cu caam); respelled by the letters
mahabi: majab'i — there is not, not yet; negative particle
cabichal: kab'ichal — (uncertain) meaning not known; paired with telen, the pair read 'on the shoulder' after Brasseur; the letters respelled
vl: ul — come, arrive here; verb, the root of kul and chul
curi: k'uri — then, and so; k'u 'then' + ri, narrative connective
naquipa: naqipa — what; naqi 'what' + pa, in naquipa rumal 'why, for what reason'
vꜭhax: uch'ax — (were) told, spoken to; u- + ch'a(w) 'speak' + passive -x, as in xe uch'ax 'they were told'
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik · mi — (inferred) do not, before a verb (mi xb'isonik 'do not grieve', after Brasseur 'ne vous affligez pas'); the form is not clear
habi: jab'i — there was, there is; existential, as in ma jab'i 'there was not' (mahabi in the preamble)
chacan: chaq'an — climbs (inferred); ch- + aq'an 'climb'; the same letters were read chakanik 'go on all fours' in the third part (xe chacanic), but here Brasseur's division ch'akan decides
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun · qaj — we want; q- 'we' (before a vowel) + aj 'want', as xkaj 'they wanted' · qaj — go down, descend (inferred); verb, as in qajik 'descending'
be: b'e — road, path; noun · b'e — go (chi b'e 'that we go'); verb, the root of xb'e 'he went'
cuꜭ: kuk' — with them; ruk' 'with him' with 3pl prefix · quk' — with us; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + uk' 'company'
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
bala: b'ala — unexplained (Brasseur 'at their ease'); uncertain · b'ala — here 'very well' after utz (Utz b'ala 'very well', after Brasseur 'C'est fort bien'); inferred · b'ala — (inferred) indeed; strengthens the word before it (qitzij b'ala 'truly indeed')
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us') · koj — we, us (ongoing); k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we, us' (coh icuxih 'you chased us') · koj — put, place; transitive verb (inferred)
zaquiric: saqirik — it dawned; saq 'white' + -ir + -ik (dawn, in a couplet with xꜫec)
xcaminac: xkaminaq — had died, dead; x- + kaminaq, kam 'die' + -inaq, the perfect
chirech: chirech — about it, of it; chi + rech 'of, belonging to it' · chirech — to him, to her (after a verb of saying)
pam: pam — belly, womb, inside; noun (cha pam 'in your belly', ꜭo chi nu pam 'in my belly')
chuxoc: chuxoq — let it be; ch- optative + ux 'become' + -oq
xqui: xki — they (did it); x- completive + ki- 3pl ergative, prefix before a transitive verb · xki — you (pl.) (doubtful); in xqui zachic, xqui ca cup, as the parallel with quix camic requires; printed as written
ban: b'an — do, make; root of the verb, here with x- completive and ki- 3pl: 'they did'
chique: chike — to them; chi 'to' + ke 'them' · chiqe — to us (inside speech); chi + qe 'us' (Ximénez's qu stands for both k and q; the toggle shows chiqe) · chike — (guess) a verb after xe, 'leaned (?)', in xe chique chuvi 'they leaned (?) over it'; not clear; Brasseur 'se tournèrent … vers le parfum'
xoh: xoj — we, us (completed action); x- completive + oj 'we, us', the absolutive, before the verb (xoh camic 'we died')
tah: taj — let it be, may it; Classical optative particle (in modern K'iche' taj is a negative) · taj — the second part of the negative ma ... taj 'not' (ma nab'e ki chakatajik taj 'not first their being brought low')
zach: sach — lose, be lost, brought to nothing (uncertain); verb (xoh zach 'we were lost')
retal: retal — its sign; r- 'its' + etal 'sign', possessed noun (xa retal 'only its sign')
quibil: kib'il — (to) themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + ib' 'self' + -il, in chi kib'il kib' 'among themselves'
quib: kib' — themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + -ib' reflexive · qib' — ourselves; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + ib' reflexive
chuxe: chuxe' — at the foot of; chu- (chi + u- 'its') + xe' 'root, foot'
cachbilan: qachb'ilan — we accompany; q- 'we' (qa- before a vowel) + achb'ilan, the verb of cachbilah with another ending · kachb'ilan — accompanying; k- 'ongoing' + achb'ilan
xebec: xeb'ek — they went; x- completive + e 'they' + b'e 'go' + -k (written c), the ending of an intransitive verb
tiquiba: tikib'a' — plant, begin (inferred; 'planting the day' taken as laying out the count of days); verb, as in xchiqatikib'a' in the preamble
chicut: chik'ut — again then, one more then; chik 'again' + k'ut 'then' written as one word, the c shared
xquil: xkil — they saw; x- completive + ki- 'they' + il 'see', without the -o of xkilo
hix: jix — go (you, pl.); the verb 'go' for 'you (pl.)', as ho 'we go'; after Brasseur (h'yx)
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e · chire — at his teeth (inferred); chi + r- 'his' + e 'tooth' · chire — because, for; conjunction (chire lib'ajchi 'because quickly')
catepuch: k'atepuch — then also; cate 'then' + puch 'also' written as one word
vpam: upam — its inside, its belly; u- 'its' + pam 'inside'
rah: raj — want (to); r- 'his, its' + aj 'want', the form of xrah, apparently fixed after a plural subject (que rah 'they want to'), the wanted act following
tocob: toq'ob' — pity; noun or verb root, as in toq'ob' nu wach 'pity my face'
vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
xecha: xecha — they said; x- completive + e- 'they' + cha 'say'
xima: xima — (inferred) tied it, bound it; xim 'tie, bind' + -a; the ending is inferred, after Brasseur ('hang up')
i: i — your (pl.); 2pl possessive prefix, as in i poy 'your effigies' · i — i- 'you (pl.)' before a verb, the ergative (i vila 'you see it', with w- before a vowel); said to one person out of respect (inferred)
chivih: chiwij — about yourselves; chi + iv- 'your (pl.)' + ih 'back' (to think behind oneself is to take thought) · chiwij — behind you (pl.), in the plain sense
vve: uwe — if, whether; we 'if' written vv (Brasseur divides u ve); the first v is not explained (uncertain)
toc: toq — (inferred) the end of petoq 'come' written apart (ke pe toq 'let them come'): the t of pet 'come' + -oq, the ending after a verb of motion
huzu: jusuk — suddenly, at once; adverb (Ximénez's huzu is huzuc with its c shared with the next word cu)
xuxic: xuxik — they came to be; x- completive + ux 'become' + -ik · xuxik — it became, he became; x- completive + ux 'become' + -ik, no plural e-, so singular (ab'aj k'ut xuxik 'he became stone')
tac: taq — plural marker 'various, several'; particle placed before a noun
chu: chu — at, by its (before a noun); let it (before a verb); chi 'at' + u- 'its' (chu jutaq chob'il 'by each division'), or ch- 'let' + u- 'it' (chu riqo 'let it find') · chu — he, it, before a verb; ch- + u- 'he', without the sense 'let' (chu maijaj 'he marvels')
cab: q'ab' — hand, arm; noun, the same word as q'ab' written with plain c · kab' — second; kab' 'two', in u kab' 'its second' (v cab, written apart), as in the ordinal ukab' · kab' — two, a pair; in u kab' 'the two of them' (v cab, written apart), after Brasseur (inferred)
chacatahic: chakatajik — being brought low; the verbal noun of chakataj 'bring low' (inferred), as in vchacatahic
naual: nawal — spirit power, spirit-double; shared with Nahuatl nahualli (Spanish nagual)
opon: opon — arrive (there); verb, arriving at a place away from the speaker (ul is 'arrive here')
cochoch: kochoch — their homes; ki- 'their' (k- before a vowel) + ochoch 'home' · qochoch — our home; qa- 'our' (q- before a vowel) + ochoch 'home'
oponic: oponik — arrived there; opon 'arrive there' + -ik, the ending of an intransitive verb (xe oponik pa … 'they arrived in …')
ruꜭ: ruk' — with him/it; relational noun r- 'its/his' + uk' 'company'
culvachih: kulwachij — (inferred) meet face to face; kul 'meet' + wach 'face' + -ij; after Brasseur ('faire trouver l'homme en face')
rax: rax — green, raw, fresh; also 'sudden' (rax kamik 'green death', Brasseur 'mort subite')
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh · we — yes; particle (Brasseur 'yes') · we — my teeth; w- 'my' + e 'tooth'
xiban: xib'an — you (pl.) did; x- completive + i- 'you (pl.)' + b'an 'do'
xin: xin — I (did); x- completive + in 'I', before an intransitive verb
mata: mata — it will not be; negative particle (uncertain)
xbizonic: xb'isonik — (inferred) worry, grieve; b'ison 'grieve, worry' + -ik, with x- before it unclear; the form is not certain
chive: chiwe — to you, by you (pl.); chi + ive
ꜫih: q'ij — day, sun; noun (Ratit Q'ij 'Grandmother of the Day'); in ki q'ij 'their day' perhaps 'their lot, fortune' (uncertain)
